strings.en: I'm not one for long-shot bets.../　I'll finish this for sure!
If you're an enemy, I have to beat you!
That's what you get for being careless!
If you're an enemy, I'll just take you down!
With this, I can keep going!
Aile Chevalier.../　You and I can do this!
Let's make our move,/　Aile Chevalier...!
Geant Chevalier and I can do this!
With the Geant Chevalier, I can hold/　my own even against a big ship!
A Zeranio-class.../　The Geant Chevalier can take it!
Forte Gigas.../　You and I can do this!
I'm good, anytime you are, Bro.
OK, leave this side to me!
Roger. We can pull it off, the two of us!
Yes, I will fight alongside you.
Yes, your enemy is my enemy as well.
Josh, I will lend you my strength.
I don't have time for your games!
Jua-Mu Dalbi, I'll show you the power/　of the Earthlings you look down on!
What's with him... He feels different from before?
Jua-Mu, if you're coming forward,/　I'll just shoot you down!
I'm forcing my way through, Jua-Mu!
That one... feels different from the others...!
Al-Van... I'm not backing down either!
That Raftclans is strong too... but still!
Your kind of logic won't win. I won't allow it!
The black Raftclans... I'll catch it!
Gu-Landon Gortz!/　You're the one I'll never forgive! I can't!
I'll end this, Gu-Landon!/　With the power of this machine you call a fake!
Whoever you are, if you attack, I'll fight!
Whoever you are, if you're an enemy...!
Like I'd let a war merchant's mercenary win!
Don't push your selfish logic on us!
What right do you have to meddle here?!
Baran-Schneil.../　A tough opponent, but there's a way to fight it!
Gomoudokka! I won't let you do as you please!
Even if it's Gadisword's commander unit!
You're getting out of my way, Vort Nikolaus!
The Cross Gate brings disaster!/　Like I'd let you use something like that!
I won't be fooled by appearances!
Debudedabide! I won't let things go your way!
Don't think you can keep laughing forever!
Debudedabide! Like I'd let you do as you please!
It doesn't care what it controls...?!
Crystal Dragoon, I'll be your opponent here!
The Crystal Dragon... Like I'd let it run wild!
Over here, Skull Knight. You're fighting me!
Target: Skull Knight. Going all out!
Whatever's inside, it's just a big weapon./　If it's a machine, there's got to be a way!
We even beat the King of Destruction/　and sealed the gate. I'll stop you too, XN-L!
Damn Zovorg... Like I'd let you do as you please!
I can't afford to struggle/　against Zovorg small fry!
Target locked: Rest Rail. Here I go!
A Geios-Grude... I'll give it a shot!
Commander unit or not, I'll stop it!
Don't think things will go/　the way you planned!
A new Zovorg model... I'll give it a shot!
What's this feeling... Is it really a Zovorg machine?
A Big Shoulder. Like I'd let you!
A horned one... I'll take it on!
If I take out the Commander's unit...!
That unit of yours really stands out!
A Thorn. A strong enemy... but still!
If I can take down the Thorn...
I have to get through this, no matter what...!
Like a Cupid could stop me!
A Gasbra. Like I'd let you!
A new model... a commander unit!
I don't know what it is... but if it's an enemy!
They might be better than the Ruina.../　but that doesn't mean I can leave them be!
Fusing made it even more intense...!
Even if it's a Kaana Type, we can do this!
Lamaris Kaana... I'll scatter you to mist!
Here it comes, the Kaana Type./　I already know how to fight it!
Even an Ida Type/　is still just a mass of Lamaris!
Don't be fooled by their movements...!
Are you saying it came back as a ghost...!
We just need to stop its movement...!
Like I'd let Dark Brain revive!
I told you I wouldn't let you!
You were too slow to pull out!
All right, this is where it starts!
Damn it, I can't take any more!!
Like hell I'll go down in a place like this!
I-I can't believe it took this much...!
I need to stay cool or I'm done for...!
Dammit, what's happening with the ADC!?
As long as the Lace Arcana is intact,/　I can still fight!
A direct hit!/　But I've been in tight spots like this before!
Tch, pathetic! To be pushed this far!
To do this much damage to the Geant...!
Don't worry about me, focus on the fight!
So that's what's causing this shaking...!
It's short for never give up.../　Rim taught me it's what you say at times like this.
Don't worry. My life exists for you.
Am I being overpowered?!/　Don't be swayed by that obsession!
Not yet, Karo-Ran! I can still fight!
S-So this is Zee-Gadin's power!/　But I won't let you! Even if it costs my life!
Like I'd let Reggiane finish me like this!
You should know the risks/　of meddling with the Cross Gate!
Debudedabide, I can't lose/　to someone like you!
Nice one, Skull Knight!/　But as long as the Res Arcana holds out!
Damn it, not yet, I can't end it here!/　Hold out until we stop the XN-L!
Hold out...! I should be able/　to go toe-to-toe with a Raftclans too!
Ngh, is the Sympathia being interfered with?!
A direct hit?! From a Lamaris?!
Ngh, output's dropping?!/　Am I getting beaten by an Ida Type?!
Ngh, how fast is that thing?!
It's not fatal! I can still go!
If the ADC works right, I can manage...!
Tch! What's a servomotor or two?!
Don't think you can shoot me down!
Guess I can't get out of this unscathed...!
Not yet!/　If this made me retreat, I wouldn't be out here!
I decided to fight as long as I'm needed./　Like I'd flinch at this!
There's still more I can do./　I can't stop over something like this!
Even the Aile Chevalier/　can't shake it off...!
I don't plan to rely on this armor, but...!
The Geant can still keep going!
The Forte Gigas can still hold out!
Big brother, the ADC can handle this!
Yeah, I'll turn this around from here!
So it landed a direct hit on the Forte Gigas.
I thought I was used to handling big machines...!
You have no need to apologize to me.
Did his ferocity overwhelm me...? Damn you, Jua-Mu!
The Raftclans really is tough...!/　At this rate I'll be cornered. I have to do something.
You're saying Fu-Ruu read my moves?!
That Raftclans is even stronger/　than Al-Van's machine...!
Damn it, Gu-Landon! How dare you!
A harsh attack, despite that tone...!
Gomoudokka.../　Like I'd let you have your way any longer!
Damn it, you got me! Out of my way, Reggiane!
If it ever becomes the key that brings in the Ruina,/　there'll be no undoing it...!
I didn't think I'd shown/　Crystal Dragoon an opening...!
Tch, Skull Knight is a pain...!
XN-L! Like this would make me flinch!
I got careless. Falling behind a Zovorg machine...!/　I won't let it go any further!
Not yet, I'll keep drawing its attention!
Ngh, the Raftclans set me up./　It read my movements...!
Ugh, damn it?!/　Damn, the Sympathia's disturbed... What is this?
I didn't mean to underestimate the Kaana Type...!
Ugh?! The Ida Type's firepower is no joke.
It's not going to go like it did with the Ares Geist...!
It's fine, this much is nothing!
I managed to avoid a direct hit...
Ngh, I should have dodged that...!
It hit me. But I'm not done yet!
For this much, I don't even need the ADC.
It's faster than the Aile Chevalier...?!
That won't get through the Geant's armor!
This much is nothing for the Geant!
Ngh, I didn't think I'd let my guard down...!
It's short for don't mind.../　Rim taught me it's what you say at times like this.
That will not work on the Forte Gigas.
But even armor has its limits./　It's not good to rely on it too much.
Al-Van... You won't let an opening slip, huh.
Karo-Ran,/　don't think that'll be enough to stop us!
Damn, I got hit by his attack!/　Gu-Landon, this is only the beginning!
I've got no intention of playing/　along with your little show!
Using the Cross Gate's power, and this is all...?
With four eyes, I guess your aim would be good...!
Skull Knight,/　did you think an attack like that could bring me down?
It hit me...!/　XN-L... does it have no blind spots...?
Thorn... not an opponent to take lightly.
Ngh... The Raftclans really is fast.
Couldn't fully dodge? Damn you, Baran-Schneil...
Hit... by a mere Lamaris. Damn it.
Kaana Type or not, if this is all it's got!
Ida Type or not, it's not that tough!/　I can do this!
Its accuracy is better than before...!
A Yokijin's got its teeth in me!
Not with an attack like that!
Like I'd let that hit me!
I've read your pattern. So then!
That won't hit me so easily!
It won't go the way you want!
Once I know where you're aiming!
Aiming for me won't help you!
If it's an attack I predicted, I'll dodge it!
You think you can catch/　the Aile Chevalier?!
Big doesn't mean I'm a sitting duck!
I'm not as slow as I look!
I'll dodge the next one too.
Keep it up next time too!
As if Josh would be hit by such an attack.
I can manage this much!/　Even against you, Al-Van!
Gu-Landon!/　You're the one I can't afford to lose to!
I can dodge this much, Crystal Dragoon.
I've seen through you, Skull Knight!
Ngh, I barely dodged that. Damn you, XN-L...
Even a Thorn's no threat if it doesn't hit.
If I read its movements, I can dodge even at that speed!
Like I'd get hit by a Lamaris attack.
Kaana Type or not,/　it's all the same if it doesn't hit.
Now I can read the next one with Clarity!
Good aim alone won't cut it!
The better the aim, the easier it is to dodge.
I can tell I'm used to fighting./　But I won't get careless.
Josh, I knew you would dodge it.
I'm not fighting alone, after all.
Karo-Ran, your attacks won't hit me!
Your attacks are too well-aimed./　That's exactly why they don't hit, Gomoudokka!
Strong... but straightforward./　Then there's a way to fight it!
I dodged it, but.../　I have to get it away from the Cross Gate.
I'm not letting my guard down, Debudedabide!
The Ida Type.../　I can't let that hit me.
Attacks like that won't work on this machine!
Not with an attack like that!
That trick won't work on me!
So we're back to square one...?!
I won't let this chance slip!
Didn't you think someone would follow up?!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Don't get too far ahead, Rim!
Rim, fall back. I'm going in next!
If you and I join forces...!
Fall back, Raki. I'll handle the rest.
Good, Raki. Leave the rest to me.
The Fabularis did it? Then me too!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'll back you up!
Guess I'll go along with/　the Lieutenant's gamble...!
Lieutenant, I'll take it from here!
Major, I'll take it from here!
Major Kai, leave the rest to me!
Latune, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Lamia, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll take it from here!
Lieutenant Aqua, I'll take it from here!
Ryusei, leave the rest to me!
Arieil, I'll take it from here!
Touya, that's the way. I'll take it from here!
I won't waste the opening Touya made!
Akemi, leave the rest to me!
I won't let them hurt my sister!
Like I'd let them get Raki!
Move, Raki! I'll take that one!
Seolla, get out while you can!
Lieutenant Hugo, leave this to me!
Touya, don't let your guard down/　in the middle of a fight!
Touya, don't get too far ahead!
I'll handle this!/　Calvina, fall back!
Akemi, that's a direct hit coming! Fall back!
I can handle at least this much!
It's got more power than before!
It handles better than you'd think...!
I'm not carrying two Les Arcanes/　just for show...!
I'll keep an eye on the gauges!
I'll watch the gauge on my end.
The Electric Cube will lock it down!
Be imprisoned in the electric cage!
It may look like a gun...
